I Tried the MOST UNIQUE Chicken Dish in Ghatshila Village! | Travel Vlog EP 07
Join me on an exciting food adventure in a beautiful village in Ghatshila, Jharkhand, where I get to experience the authentic Chicken Potla – a traditional dish wrapped in sal leaves and cooked to perfection over an open fire!
This rare and flavorful recipe is a hidden culinary gem, deeply rooted in village traditions and local flavors. In this vlog, I’ll take you through the entire cooking process, introduce you to the amazing villagers, and give you a taste of the rich cultural heritage of Ghatshila.
